name: EasyCraft Online
storyline:
In the world of Valoria, an ancient catastrophe known as the Fragmentation destroyed the balance between realms, corrupting creatures and plunging the land into chaos. Entire civilizations crumbled and survivors took refuge in small fortified villages.

You are an adventurer who arrives at the Village of Dawn, the last bastion of resistance. Guided by NPCs like Boneco (the training master), Mira (the merchant), Thalos (the legendary blacksmith) and Varen (the wise elder), you must choose your path among the arts of the Warrior, Mage or Archer.

Your mission is to explore the corrupted lands, face the creatures that emerged after the Fragmentation, uncover the secrets of the Crypt and its dungeons, and gather resources to strengthen the village. Form guilds with other adventurers, compete in the PvP arena, master the marketplace trade and evolve your skills to face ever greater threats.

The fate of Valoria depends on you. Forge your weapons, conquer your enemies and rewrite the history of this broken world.
summary:
EasyCraft is an online idle RPG set in the world of Valoria, where players take on the role of adventurers tasked with rebuilding a fragmented civilization. Choose from three classes: Warrior, Mage, or Archer, each with three advanced subclasses, and embark on a journey of battles, exploration, and conquest.

The game features real-time turn-based manual combat, automated resource gathering battles, over 200 items with random rarities and attributes, item crafting, resource gathering, equipment enchanting, and durability systems. Explore the Crypt, dangerous dungeons filled with monsters and rare rewards. Interact with NPCs like Doll, Mira, Thalos, and Varen in a village that serves as your base of operations.

Features include guilds with collective abilities, a PvP arena, a player marketplace, a pet system, quests, competitive rankings, real-time chat, daily rewards, and appearance customization. Play directly in your browser or through the desktop application.
